Based on review of comments, it seems this is used to mark a subset of JIT helpers as being in managed code

For `arm64` it currently includes
```
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_MemSet)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_MemCpy)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_WriteBarrier)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_CheckedWriteBarrier)
```

Shouldn't it also include 
```
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_ByRefWriteBarrier)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_Stelem_Ref)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_Stelem_Ref_NotExactMatch)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_Stelem_DoWrite)
    CHECK_RANGE(JIT_Stelem_Ref)
```

I am assuming the stubs are not needed, because they are generated by the JIT and treated as managed code.  It would be really nice to understand the classification rules, constraints and requirements.

Also based on my read, these functions will effectively get retried if a signal occurs, signal will return to the caller, to call the helper again.  So these functions have functional constraints as well to not modify the call arguments.  Is my understanding here correct?
